claim: TP4 9B demo second crash root-caused from the operator's worker.out (run 21:17-22:20, engine ready 3606.8s, exit code -9). TWO defects found. (1) RETRACTION of CP-0147: its max_total_tokens=256 never took effect — the worker read env DEMO_MAX_TOKENS (the generation count, 20) instead of DEMO_MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS; the server_args dump in worker.out proves max_total_tokens=20 against the 19-token prompt. Worker now reads DEMO_MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS and a pre-load guard rejects prompt+generation that the pools cannot hold at ~30s (tokenize time) instead of one hour in. (2) The -9 was SGLang's crash escalation after every rank's first collective — the embedding all-reduce, where lazy NCCL first establishes its Socket transport — failed with 'Call to bind failed: Cannot assign requested address' (4x in worker.out lines 2899/2974/3050/3125). A 4-rank probe over the identical build_worker_env (2 all-reduces, zero weight loading, ~15s engine-free) shows: unpinned NCCL passes today, so the demo failure was transient host interface churn — AgentENV (CP-0145) firecracker veth-* interfaces are created/destroyed dynamically and NCCL's automatic interface pick races them; the IP form NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=127.0.0.1 is REJECTED by RCcl 2.27 ('Bootstrap : no socket interface found', all ranks die instantly); NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo completes both all-reduces on all 4 ranks, NCCL picking lo:127.0.0.1 (not aenv's 10.255.255.254). demo_gen.py now pins NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo, sets NCCL_DEBUG=INFO / SUBSYS INIT,NET so any recurrence names its interface, and the parent prints the worker.out tail on any crash.
